Hey! You! What comes to mind when you think about Christmas?

There's a rumor that Santa Claus lives in a certain village all throughout the year.
You guys can meet Santa on either of the five possible villages throughout Rune-Midgerts!
If you win over Santa, you can get a gift. Would you go for it?
Isn't it thrilling to open gifts over your head!!
Some villain, a fake Santa robbed some gifts from the good Santa!
Furthermore, he has put bad magic on the gifts so that they become monsters!
Ah, a music box is useful.
Though we can't all play it around the village as we planned, it's cool that you carry it.
We want to enjoy carols all together... I hope to get Crystal Pieces!
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
Why not? Sure, I can give you some.
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
I can bake you a cake, and I can carve your name on the cake, if you want!
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
Anyway, thanks a lot for your help.

So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
I've been waiting for this for when
But there's been no caroling here and there like before, so we can't feel the Christmas spirit.
So, I installed a Singing Crystal in Prontera...
but that jerk Antonio broke the crystal!
The gift boxes have been changing into monsters since Antonio placed some magic on them, so the monsters ate up the crystal fragments!
I am so devastated, since the Singing Crystal has been the hope of many children around the villages.
There's no other way to carol?
You can hear carols in Lutie.
And just stay there, every Christmas, for your whole life?
Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
...Why are you staring at me like that?
You're thinking that we are always getting our plans spoiled, aren't you?
I know that we are not good at controlling stuff, but our rewards are good, right?
You are so cruel to me!
Please bring me 6 Singing Crystal Pieces from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
You know, the santa costumes that the monsters are wearing now aren't genuine!
The rumor 'round here is, Lutie's designer made these costumes.
Every year, adventurers challenge to attack Antonio the fake Santa, but there's no way to catch up to him due to his hat and costume!
Are there some special abilities within them?
There's still the designer in the Christmas village... How about asking her to make that costume?
As I heard, this Antonio is quite different from before.
He seems to be quite resolved with himself since he ran away from people before.
And he isn't alone anymore... is what I heard...
Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
For all of the children of this world!!!
Please bring me ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Santa won't give you a gift if you're crying.
They are so cruel, aren't they?
I'm happy to see you again.
All right! We can start to make our music box with crystal fragments.
We would amplify the sounds of the crystal fragments to sound through the music box.
You know, a music box that sounds like a jukebox!
It's handy. You can carry it, as well as listen to sweet carols anywhere.
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
We can make a music box with Singing Crystal Pieces.
It's handy, you can hear carols anywhere. Sounds cool?
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!

Did you bring all the materials?
No need to hesitate! Let's get started to make our music box.
Blacksmith hammers on trunk... and we shape the frame.
Please use the Singing Crystal Pieces for a column, the Diamond as a prop, and the Sticky Mucus as glue.
It's so cool! Isn't it cute!!?!
You did as I requested, so I will give you gifts, as promised.
Please play this music box all over the villages!
Another present is a Christmas cake especially shaped like your name!
I made this cake shaped like your name!
Wow! Were you naughty or nice this year?
All right, what comes to your mind when you think about Christmas?
A sweet carol always makes Christmas more happy!!!
Yes indeed Carolling spreads Joy throughout the world?
Ho ho ho! What a good boy!
Ho ho ho! What a good girl!
But you should be wary of a fake Santa romaing around.
Have you heard of Antonio, who invades villages every Christmas?
He has stolen my gifts, as well as attacked adventurers around Toy and Lutie field.
A bad Santa ruins us good Santa's reputations!
The World Santa Organization is considering this a grave situation.
A gift box! That sounds good!
It's so exciting to open gift boxes when you wake up on Christmas morning!!!
But we have very little gifts now, since Santa Antonio has stolen my gift bag.
Many adventurers try to catch up to him, but he is not easy to catch.
Anyway let those adventurers try to catch him, I have a small game for you.
I will give you a small gift if you beat me!
Do you want to play a game with me?
If you've been a little naughty this year I won't stuff your stockings with coal.
I will stay here throughout the Christmas season, just visit me when you change your mind.
Um... You've played the game recently haven't you?
You can try the game once a hour.
Please visit me after the one hour has passed.
Let me explain how to play this game.
I will pick one of three cards: Poring Card, Ghostring Card, and Angeling Card.
Guess which card I pick and you're a winner!
If you guess right 3 times out of 5, I will give you a gift.
First let me shuffle up these cards... Ok!!!
Can you guess the right card the next time around?
Now this gift is for you.
Put your hand into the bag and pick only one.
Good job! Thanks for playing the card game with me!
Do you mean that ever so fashionable costume for Santa's and youngsters!?!
Light-weight, fashionable, and keeps you warm!
There used to be designer who visited my house to make my Santa costumes.
You should open your heart to the spirit of Christmas!
Once you do, I know you'll be able to think of something.
I always thought about how boring Santa Claus is wearing a too boring costume.
I could make a glamorous style for him!
I once made a costume for the notorious figure Antonio!
The reason catching up to him is so hard, is that his clothes have been given strong power!
I blessed them with good luck!
Which is quite luxurious but sold at good price ~
You can share my sense of fashion and wear my look if you run a light mission for me.
You're silly! You lost your big chance!
Come to me later if you want to get the mission.
I, Louise Kim, am generous enough to accept you next time.
I'm only in need of some materials. Things that are beyond my ability...
Anyway, can you bring me some stuff?
Why not? What do you need?
You need to bring me: ^0000FFCotton Shirt, 3 Red Potion, Holy Water, 4 Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Lace^000000.
If you bring me all that stuff, I can make you a glamorous Santa costume.
If you were to bring me all the stuff, I would make you a wonderful costume, for free...
Please see me again if you are interested.
I will show you my limitless ability.
All over the world will be blessed tonight!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!
I am a genius of the world.
You can call it what you wish.
I ain't envious of Designer Pierre.
I am supposed to get paid well, however I will just let it be free, since this is Christmas!
Go brag about these wonderful clothes. There wouldn't be any without me, Louise Kim.
